anchor_sampling: same existing Bernoulli-10% supported train anchors; one 32k*128 pass per arm, fixed seed permutation; no low-ratio/Listen+ threshold
primary_estimand: within-reference beta-specific exact-q gap and full-catalog ranking/expected frozen RM; report Pareto points against same full43 parent, no cross-beta objective-gap comparison

qualitative_predictions.beta_direction: beta=0.03 puts stronger relative weight on the frozen RM tilt than beta=0.1; beta=0.3 puts stronger weight on the exact KL-to-parent term.
qualitative_predictions.decision_readout: Report all three beta values (0.03, 0.1, 0.3) as exploratory validation Pareto points for NDCG@100 and expected frozen RM; do not choose a winner from reused validation/test outcomes.
qualitative_predictions.interpretation_limit: Exact-q gaps are beta-specific optimizer diagnostics and are not comparable across beta values; no user-response or long-horizon claim.

context_reinforce8_advantage: per-sample frozen history-only baseline: R(h,a)-R_history(h), detached; mean over 8 iid actions; no group centering or reward normalization
full_parent_anchor_history: parent full-supported seed43, 41,142,628 training exposures; continued arms use pinned subset feature dataset and same Bernoulli-10% 4,110,754 anchor pool
